title: Ducco's Pumpkins
description: Simple personal change for pumpkins if anyone is interested
body:
I love making resource packs but I cant really upload them as most of what I do is take elements from other packs and either leave them as is or tweak them to my liking, these pumpkins are my own work.

![Pumpkins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90100faac0ebfe3493039cc30460679df2c8cf55.png)

If the red border bothers you then you can change the pack format manually using these links as a guide:
https://minecraft.wiki/w/Pack_format
https://minecraft.wiki/w/Pack.mcmeta


Either that or you can download this mod:
https://modrinth.com/mod/no-resource-pack-warnings
